fi-atractostues-spatula.title: Alligator Gar
fi-atractostues-spatula.summary: The alligator gar, Atractosteus spatula, is a gar from the lower Mississippi basin and Gulf Coast states of the south-eastern USA and Mexico. One of the largest freshwater fishes in the world, it…
rows: Best alone or with carefully chosen tankmates
Usually kept singly (or a known pair when breeding)
Carnivore / micropredator. Gars are ambush predators feedimg on smaller fishes and aquatic crustaceans in nature.
Native to central and south-eastern states of the USA plus northern and central Mexico .
notes: Relatively unfussy provided water flow is not too strong and lighting not bright.
